name: No-Scope Arcade [NEW]
desc:
No-Scope Arcade is a fast-paced, adrenaline-pumping, movement-based first-person shooter! Run through the battleground arena to squash the competition and come out as the ultimate winner. Do you have what it takes to be more skilled than your opponents?

Unlock gun skins, character skins, bullet tracers, kill effects, and melee weapons with the tokens you get rewarded. Evade your enemies with jumping, sliding, and wall-hopping movements to avoid being shot.

Want to support the game and team? Awesome!
